description: This Java enum class defines different streaming types used in the project, including methods for identifying and handling these types based on signals and pub/sub topics.

classes.name: StreamingType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different types of data streams (e.g., events, messages, live commands). It also provides methods for mapping strings to enum types and identifying the stream type of signals.

methods.name: getDistributedPubSubTopic
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub topic key associated with the streaming type.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Converts a string pub/sub topic into the corresponding StreamingType enum, throws exception if unknown.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Checks if a given signal belongs to the live channel.

methods.name: fromSignal
methods.description: Infers the most appropriate StreamingType based on the given signal, returning an Optional of StreamingType.
